name: Pacific Union Club (Flood Mansion)
note: 1886 brownstone Italianate mansion, Nob Hill; walls survived the 1906 fire. Rusticated base, pedimented piano-nobile windows, attic, rooftop balustrade.

name: San Francisco Columbarium
note: 1898 Neoclassical domed rotunda of funerary niches; cream drum, entrance colonnade, copper-green dome.

name: Octagon House
note: 1861 Colonial Revival octagon house, Cow Hollow; white clapboard, low hip roof, small cupola.

name: Feusier Octagon House
note: 1857-59 octagon house, Russian Hill; grey clapboard, taller than the Gough St octagon, mansard-roofed cupola.

name: Lands End Lookout
note: The Park Service visitor centre (2012): board-formed concrete wall with the sea-green tile name band, clerestory, thin flat roof, timber behind, blue steel canopy at the east end (owner photographs, 2026-10-06).

name: Camera Obscura
note: Tiny box-camera-shaped shed at the Cliff House site, with a lens barrel projecting seaward.

name: Cliff House
note: 1909 Neo-Classical Reid Brothers building at the cliff edge; low massing, cream stucco, wide sea-facing windows, balustraded parapet.

name: City Lights Booksellers
note: Ordinary small North Beach commercial building, cream paint; famous for the bookstore, not the architecture — a recipe is the right answer.

name: Vesuvio
note: Small North Beach bar building opposite City Lights across Jack Kerouac Alley; dark red-brown paint, recipe facade.
